description: Rebates for New and Used Electric Vehicles in Nova Scotia is a dataset listed in Province of Nova Scotia open data portal (data.novascotia.ca), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Province of Nova Scotia. The province is strengthening its commitment to address climate change and grow the economy with its new Electric Vehicle Rebate program. The rebate program gives Nova Scotians of varying income levels to take part in the shift to clean transportation. The Clean Foundation administers the point-of-sale rebate program through auto dealers and bicycle retailers. Coverage: Nova Scotia. The portal files it under the category Mines and Minerals. Its tags are climate change, transportation, ev, electric vehicle, clean transportation. The table has 6 columns. The portal shows 2025-05-05 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Nova Scotia Open Government Licence. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-novascotia-ca-portal.
